title: Validate Binary Search Tree
description: Given the root of a binary tree in level order, determine if it is a valid binary search tree (BST). Output `true` or `false`.
input_format: First line contains `n`. Second line contains level order tokens.
output_format: true if valid BST, false otherwise.

sample_tests.explanation: Root value 5 is greater than right child 4.
Single node is always valid BST.

hints: Every node in the left subtree must be strictly less than the node's key.
Every node in the right subtree must be strictly greater than the node's key.
Pass `(min_allowed, max_allowed)` boundaries down the recursion.

starter_code.python:

import sys

    data = sys.stdin.read().split()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    solve()
